purpose: Shared HTML input regex patterns and validation titles for customer and admin forms.
businessRules: OTP inputs must accept exactly 6 digits.
Login identity accepts either a valid email address or an Indian mobile number with optional +91 prefix.
Admin key inputs should use lowercase snake_case unless the backend contract explicitly uses enum-safe uppercase values.
Reusable regex strings should be imported from this module instead of being duplicated in page components.
